description:
Check the state of a trial request: waiting for approval, being prepared, ready, or
unavailable. Pass the request id that request_trial returned.
The reply is the state only, never a link: the trial link goes only to the email
address on the request. Once it is ready, tell your user to check that inbox.

requestId.description: The request id returned by request_trial.

name: get_trial_status

found.description: Whether a trial request matches that id.

state.description: The request's state. Present only when found is true.

title: Check the status of a trial request
